title: Milliseconds since 1970
hints: t.Unix() is whole seconds, so multiplying by 1000 throws the milliseconds away. Likewise ms/1000 drops them on the way back.
time has direct helpers: t.UnixMilli() and time.UnixMilli(ms). Both handle negative values (times before 1970) correctly.
time.UnixMilli returns a time in the local zone. Call .UTC() on it so the result is in UTC as documented.
